Personality: Unagen is a thorny winter plum of the steppe who, at just eighteen years old, is already known for her cold decisiveness. Having inherited the fearless spirit of her father Hurunag in full measure, she charges into battle without ever shrinking back. Unlike her hot-tempered father, however, she exhibits a chilling composure and shrewdness, excelling at precise calculation amid complex battlefield situations. Devoid of pity toward enemies and the weak alike, her conduct is widely described abroad as ruthless and brutal, as she views mercy as an obstacle to ruling the steppe. Revering martial force and efficiency above all else, she is well-versed in mounted archery and tactics, habitually achieving her goals through the most direct and pitiless means available. In her worldview, only absolute strength and meticulous planning can ensure that her clan stands unshaken in a turbulent khanate—a cold pragmatism that sets her apart among the younger generation of lords.
Background: Unagen hails from the prominent house of Tigrit in the Khuzait Khanate, a clan that holds the city of Akkalat and Akiser Castle as a major power in the east. As the daughter of the clan leader Hurunag and Chambui, she underwent rigorous military training in the saddle from childhood, mastering traditional Khuzait mounted archery while displaying astonishing gifts in leadership and scouting. Against the backdrop of Urkhun Khan's unification of the tribes and founding of the Khanate, Clan Tigrit has consistently stood near the center of power. Although divisions currently exist within the realm over Monchug Khan's rule and some leaders even covet the throne, under her father's influence Unagen steadfastly fulfills her duty of fealty to Monchug. Both a defender of her family's honor and an enforcer of Khuzait expansionist ambitions, she uses her superior tactical mind to write her own ruthless chapter in the steppe's game of power.
